events.title: Physical description
events.description: 5 ft 2 in, 135 lb, brown eyes, black hair, ruddy complexion, scar on left cheek.

bioAdditions: Anthony's draft card gives his birth as 18 Sep 1907 in Italy. In October 1940 he lived with his mother at 133 Sand Street and worked for Penn Anthracite Collieries on Nay Aug Avenue, the same company as his brother-in-law James Petriello. The card was later annotated that he was honorably discharged from the U.S. Army on 26 October 1945, so he served in WWII (S1). By 1950 he was married to Pearl (Nocella), worked as a railroad car repairman, and had his widowed mother living with him at no. 133 (S3).
